title: Fivetran Connector Paused or Broken
dataSources: Fivetran REST API connector status (`fivetran:connector`), log-service sync events (`fivetran:log`), and usage/MAR exports.
app: Fivetran REST API (`/v1/connectors`, `/v1/metadata`) and Fivetran Platform Connector logs via HEC scripted inputs; Fivetran log-service events (`fivetran:log`).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=fivetran:connector
| stats latest(paused) as paused, latest(sync_state) as sync_state, latest(setup_state) as setup_state by connector_id
| where paused="true" OR setup_state="broken" OR setup_state="incomplete"
| sort connector_id
description: Reports Fivetran connectors that are paused or in a broken/incomplete setup state, which stop delivering data without generating a sync failure.
value: A paused or broken connector silently stops the data flow; polling connector state catches the outage that failure alerts miss entirely.
implementation: Poll the Fivetran connectors API into HEC; schedule every 15 minutes and alert when a production connector is paused or broken.
visualization: Table of connector by state, status panel.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure every data connector is switched on and healthy so none quietly stops delivering data.
